description: Angular component for selecting rule chains with autocomplete functionality, including fetching rule chains from a service, handling user input, and managing component state.

classes.name: RuleChainSelectPanelComponent
classes.description: Angular component for rule chain selection with autocomplete.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Sets focus to the input element after view initialization.

methods.name: selected
methods.description: Handles selection of a rule chain from autocomplete options.

methods.name: fetchRuleChains
methods.description: Fetches rule chains matching the search text, with error handling.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Marks the input as dirty and updates validity on focus.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the input field and resets focus.

methods.name: getRuleChains
methods.description: Calls the rule chain service to retrieve rule chains based on page link.
